title: The Green Hill Solar Farm Order 2026
summary: This Order authorises Green Hill Solar Farm Limited (referred to in this Order as the undertaker) to construct, operate, maintain and decommission a ground mounted solar photovoltaic generating station with a gross electrical output capacity over 100 megawatts and associated development. The Order would permit the undertaker to acquire, compulsorily or by agreement, land and rights in land and to use land for this purpose.

title: The County Borough of the Vale of Glamorgan (Electoral Arrangements) Order 2026 / Gorchymyn Bwrdeistref Sirol Bro Morgannwg (Trefniadau Etholiadol) 2026
summary: This Order implements the recommendations of the Democracy and Boundary Commission Cymru (“the Commission”), which reported in January 2026 on its review of the electoral arrangements for the County Borough of the Vale of Glamorgan. The Commission’s report proposed an increase in the number of electoral wards from 24 to 26 and an increase in the number of councillors from 58 to 59.

title: The County Borough of Caerphilly (Electoral Arrangements) Order 2026 / Gorchymyn Bwrdeistref Sirol Caerffili (Trefniadau Etholiadol) 2026
summary: This Order implements the recommendations of the Democracy and Boundary Commission Cymru (“the Commission”), which reported in March 2026 on its review of the electoral arrangements for the County Borough of Caerphilly. The Commission’s report proposed a reduction in the number of electoral wards from 31 to 30 and a decrease in the number of councillors from 69 to 68.

title: The County of Carmarthenshire (Electoral Arrangements) Order 2026 / Gorchymyn Sir Gaerfyrddin (Trefniadau Etholiadol) 2026
summary: This Order implements the recommendations of the Democracy and Boundary Commission Cymru (“the Commission”), which reported in January 2026 on its review of the electoral arrangements for the County of Carmarthenshire. The Commission’s report proposed a reduction in the number of electoral wards from 51 to 47 and a decrease in the number of councillors from 75 to 74. title: The Insolvency (Amendment) (2026 Act) (Commencement No. 1 and Transitional Provisions) Order (Northern Ireland) 2026
summary: This Order is the first commencement order made under the Insolvency (Amendment) Act (Northern Ireland) 2026 (“the 2026 Act”).

title: The Steeple Renewables Project Order 2026
summary: This Order grants development consent for, and authorises the construction, operation and maintenance of a solar generating station and battery energy storage facility together with associated development. This Order imposes requirements in connection with the development and authorises the compulsory purchase of land (including rights in land) and the right to use land and to override easements and other rights.

title: The Scotland Act 1998 (Specification of Functions and Transfer of Property etc.) (Amendment) Order 2026
summary: This Order amends the Scotland Act 1998 (Specification of Functions and Transfer of Property etc.) Order 2019 (S.I. 2019/183) (“the 2019 Order”) to remove reference to the Scottish Ministers’ functions under section 44 of the Climate Change (Scotland) Act 2009 (asp 12), because there are no functions under section 44 that could be exercised by way of arrangements under section 93 of the Scotland Act 1998 (c. 46).

title: The Scottish Administration (Offices) Order 2026
summary: This Order specifies the Clerk of the Sexual Offences Court and Deputy Clerks of the Sexual Offences Court as offices in the Scottish Administration which are not ministerial offices for the purposes of the Scotland Act 1998.

title: The School Teachers’ Pay and Conditions (England) Order 2026
summary: This Order makes provision for the determination of the remuneration of school teachers (within the meaning of section 122 of the Education Act 2002 (c. 32)) in England and other conditions of employment of school teachers which relate to their professional duties and working time.

title: The Crime and Policing Act 2026 (Commencement No. 4) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations bring into force specified provisions of the Crime and Policing Act 2026 (c. 20) (“the Act”). These are the fourth commencement regulations made under the Act.

title: The Official Controls (Plant Protection Products) (Amendment) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2026
summary: These Regulations amend the Official Controls (Plant Protection Products) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2020 (S.R. 2020 No.360) (“PPP Official Controls Regulations”)

title: The Building (Local Authority Charges and Amendments Relating to Charging) (England) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations set out provisions in relation to charges of local authorities for or in connection with certain building related functions.

summary: These Regulations amend the Welfare Food Regulations 1996 (S.I. 1996/1434) (“the 1996 Regulations”). title: The First-tier Tribunal and Upper Tribunal (Chambers) (Amendment No. 2) Order 2026
summary: The First-tier Tribunal and Upper Tribunal (Chambers) Order 2010 (S.I. 2010/2655) (“the 2010 Order”) organises the First-tier Tribunal and Upper Tribunal into chambers and makes provision for the allocation of those tribunals’ functions between the chambers.
